requestSource.description: Which rule operation to evaluate: AverageAssessment, DelegatedAuthorityLookup, or SubrogationThreshold. Omit it to get every rule value back in one call.

scenario.description: Claim scenario driving the rule outcome (e.g. Standard, Underinsured, Displaced, Investigated, Declined, Reopened).

policyLimitIndemnity.description: Indemnity limit on the liability policy schedule.

policyLimitCosts.description: Legal costs limit on the liability policy schedule.

estimatedCost.description: Estimated full value of the injury claim including damages and costs.

contributoryNegligenceFlag.description: Whether a contributory negligence deduction was applied to the settlement (AverageAssessment only).

authorityLimit.description: The applicable sign-off authority limit (AverageAssessment or DelegatedAuthorityLookup).

minimumPursuitValue.description: Minimum claim value at which recovery against the third party insurer is considered (SubrogationThreshold only).

pursueRecovery.description: Whether recovery against the third party insurer should be pursued (SubrogationThreshold only).

script.code: /* Contributory negligence deduction: settlement = full value x (1 - claimant contribution). Where the claimant contributed to the accident, damages are reduced proportionally; policyLimitIndemnity + policyLimitCosts are the liability policy limits available to meet the reduced award in this scenario check. */ const requestSource = $workflow.input.requestSource; const scenario = $workflow.input.scenario || 'Standard'; const policyLimitIndemnity = $workflow.input.policyLimitIndemnity; const policyLimitCosts = $workflow.input.policyLimitCosts; const estimatedCost = $workflow.input.estimatedCost; if (requestSource === 'AverageAssessment') { const contributoryNegligenceFlag = scenario === 'Underinsured'; const authorityLimit = 35000; return { contributoryNegligenceFlag: contributoryNegligenceFlag, authorityLimit: authorityLimit }; } if (requestSource === 'DelegatedAuthorityLookup') { const authorityLimit = 150000; return { authorityLimit: authorityLimit }; } if (requestSource === 'SubrogationThreshold') { const minimumPursuitValue = 750; const pursueRecovery = typeof estimatedCost === 'number' ? estimatedCost >= minimumPursuitValue : false; return { minimumPursuitValue: minimumPursuitValue, pursueRecovery: pursueRecovery }; } const minimumPursuitValue = 750; return { contributoryNegligenceFlag: scenario === 'Underinsured', authorityLimit: 35000, minimumPursuitValue: minimumPursuitValue, pursueRecovery: typeof estimatedCost === 'number' ? estimatedCost >= minimumPursuitValue : false };
